_comment: 在室状況 (M140, docs/PRESENCE.md §2.2): the solid badge every client draws a state in — the state's colour key (attendance_states.color, the 8 text emoji keys of apps/shared/text-emoji.json) as a solid background with white text and icon, the same in the light and the dark theme. Every shade keeps `fg` at WCAG AA against it: at least `min_text_contrast` for the name (small text) and `min_icon_contrast` for the icon. Each client keeps a copy and a test compares it with this file and checks the contrast.
